title: Transitland Atlas feed source evaluation
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Records why a feed URL was or was not registered in Atlas, and which publisher pages are worth re-checking. One file per subject, named for its Onestop ID: an operator where one exists, otherwise a feed, since most feeds rely on generated operators. Holds current state, not an append-only log: git history is the log.

operator_onestop_id.description: Operator this file is about. Must exist in feeds/. Use feed_onestop_id instead when the feed relies on a generated operator.

candidates.description: Feed URLs that have been evaluated, including ones deliberately not registered.

watch.description: Pages worth re-checking, typically because they publish a URL that moves.

feed_onestop_id.description: Feed this file is about, when the feed has no operator record. Must exist in feeds/.

us_ntd_id.description: US National Transit Database id, for an agency Atlas does not hold at all. Only valid when no operator carries this id: once one does, the file is renamed to that operator. Five characters, zero-padded, as NTD publishes them.

name.description: Human-readable name of the subject. Only useful on an externally-keyed file, where no Atlas record supplies one.

url.description: The URL evaluated. For a negative finding, the URL that does not work.

decision.description: used = registered. not_used = works, but we chose something else. deferred = not now, recheck later. unavailable = cannot be used for reasons outside our control.

relationship.description: How this URL's contents relate to what is registered for this operator. Same vocabulary as feed-probe (interline-io/tlv2#439), so an automated probe can re-verify the assertion later.

relates_to.description: Registered feeds this comparison was made against. More than one when a candidate spans several feeds.

decided_on.description: Date of the decision. Required, because every finding here decays.

recheck_after.description: Date after which the basis for this decision may no longer hold, e.g. when a calendar expires.

rationale.description: Why, in plain terms. State measurements, not judgments about a vendor or agency: this repository is public. Any figures quoted are frozen evidence for the decision and are not maintained.

references.description: Supporting links: agency pages, vendor directories, issues. Do not record PR numbers, which git history already resolves.

publishes.description: Feeds whose URL this page publishes.

last_seen_url.description: URL last observed on the page, to diff against on the next check.

note.description: What to look for, and why this page needs watching.
